fact: The PADES II programme document of 19 June 2024 says SIMEN, of the Ministère de l'Éducation nationale, has developed PLANETE, which manages data on pupils and teachers, timetables, assessments and marks, the school report and pupils' absences and lateness, and GREEN, which issues each pupil a unique national identifier (IEN); it says the existing SIGE is fed mostly by DPRE's annual data collection using StatEduc, and gives no count of schools using PLANETE.
title: Programme d'appui au développement de l'éducation au Sénégal - PADES II : Document de programme
